name: skills
description: The Utopia Studio's skill marketplace. Four modules — GTM, Product, Investments, and Founder Productivity — 347 skills for founders, fellows, and the funds team. Maintained by Karan Pinto.

plugins.name: utopia-gtm
plugins.description: Go-to-Market — positioning, sales, outbound, signals, content, paid, RevOps, retention, and agent governance. Everything to launch and grow.

plugins.name: utopia-product
plugins.description: Product — discovery, PRDs, design, build, deploy, and product metrics. Everything to define and ship the product.

plugins.name: utopia-investments
plugins.description: Investments — due diligence, financial modeling, valuation, capital markets, fundraising decks, and quant pricing. For funds team and fundraising.

plugins.name: utopia-founder-productivity
plugins.description: Founder Productivity — onboarding frameworks, legal docs, knowledge management, agents, and operator tools that don't fit GTM, Product, or Investments.
